name: PET and polyester
principle: Terephthalic acid or dimethyl terephthalate is reacted with ethylene glycol to make PET by continuous melt polycondensation. thyssenkrupp Uhde Inventa-Fischer's Melt-To-Resin (MTR) process uses a two-reactor design (ESPREE and DISCAGE) and skips the separate solid-state step; a 324,000 t/yr plant for KÖKSAN in Turkey is planned for 2028.

source.note: Hydrocarbon Processing, thyssenkrupp Uhde to build a low-emission polyester plant for KÖKSAN in Turkey, April 2026
